rationale: Retain accepted numerical Very low proxies. Documented decapods53–60 differ from nondecapod amphipods/isopods61 and unspecified Zooplankton65. Common-name decapod interpretation is stronger than generic ecological metadata, but cannot establish unobserved composition or justify exclusions. Group65 biomass dominance76.3366% is unobserved and composition-sensitive, not demonstrated caught mass. Broad aquatic-invertebrate union48–65 remains a weak ecological proxy, not exhaustive demersal taxonomy.
root_decision: Adopted root instruction; no invertebrate numerical alteration
